title: Measurement Guide
content:
## How to Measure for Wallpaper

1. Measure wall width and height in feet.
2. Subtract doors and windows.
3. Multiply width × height × number of walls.
4. Add 10% wastage for pattern matching.
5. Use our calculator for rolls and pricing.

*Guide content.*

title: Material Guide
content:
## Wallpaper Materials

**Non-Woven** — breathable, easy to install.
**Vinyl** — wipe-clean, durable.
**Grasscloth & Silk Effect** — textured luxury.
**Metallic & Foil** — reflective accents.

*Guide content.*

title: Wallpaper Care Guide
content:
## Caring for Your Wallpaper

Dust regularly with a soft brush. Spot-clean with a damp cloth for washable finishes. Avoid abrasive cleaners and prolonged moisture on non-vinyl products.

*Guide content.*

title: Installation Guide
content:
## Installing Wallpaper

Prep the wall, apply adhesive, align the first drop, smooth with a brush, and butt-join remaining drops. Our product pages include per-design instructions.

*Guide content.*
